issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), and Ministry of Public Security (MPS)
covered_actors: Application distribution platforms (such as internet app stores)
Any organizations and individuals using deep synthesis services or handling deep synthesis markings
prohibited_practices: Using deep synthesis services to produce, copy, publish, or disseminate information prohibited by laws and administrative regulations

Using deep synthesis services to endanger national security and interests, damage national image, infringe social public interests, disrupt economic and social order, or infringe others' lawful rights and interests
Using deep synthesis services to produce, copy, publish, or disseminate false news information
Providing information publishing services to deep synthesis service users who have not completed real-identity information authentication
Using technical means to delete, tamper with, or conceal required implicit or conspicuous deep synthesis markings
enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (national and local cyberspace administration departments)
State Council and local telecommunications authorities (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology)
Ministry of Public Security and local public security organs
Press and publication, culture and tourism, and radio and television authorities (for sectoral online publishing, cultural, and audiovisual services)
penalties_summary: Under Articles 21 and 22, authorities may order providers and technical supporters with major information security risks to suspend information updates, user account registration, or other related services and rectify hidden dangers; violations are penalized under relevant laws and administrative regulations with heavier penalties for serious consequences, public security administration penalties by public security organs for public security violations, and criminal liability where acts constitute crimes.
implementation_notes: Promulgated as Joint Order No. 12 under the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, and Administrative Measures for Internet Information Services. Applies to deep synthesis services provided within PRC territory. Links algorithm filing obligations for services with public opinion attributes or social mobilization capabilities to the Provisions on the Administration of Algorithm-Generated Recommendations for Internet Information Services (Article 19) and requires concurrent compliance with press/publication, culture/tourism, and radio/television rules where applicable (Article 24).
